  Scenario: AC5 Role without the Litigation right is refused (X2)
    Given a caller whose role does not include the Litigation right
    When the caller calls API-S4-002 or reads the step outcome
    Then the call is refused with MSG-P4-002 before any change
    Then nothing is instructed and nothing moves

  Scenario: AC6 A statement reaches a protected object (X11)
    Given a component, a statement or a test that reaches a partner_instruction row, a recovery_case row, a document body, a v_ace_* view or another service's schema
    When the build runs the boundary test
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC7 Only this service evaluates the rules and writes no other owner's row (BR1, BR3, BR4, BR5, BR6)
    Given the rwb-case, rwb-partner and rwb-document contract mocks answer the step
    When the firm-instruction step runs for "RC-2026-000609"
    Then the rules are evaluated in rwb_litigation and in no other service
    Then no partner, partner_instruction, recovery_case or document row and no v_ace_* view is written or joined

  Scenario: AC8 The decision is recorded before anything changes, with its rule and version (BR2)
    Given the LITIGATION rule package is in force at its version
    When firm matched
    Then the decision record holds the rule ID and the package version before the instruction is requested
    Then the case moves to FIRM_INSTRUCTED only after the record is written

  Scenario: AC9 The same signal twice writes once (BR7)
    Given the case "RC-2026-000609" and firm "LF-2026-0009" signal arrives twice
    When the repeat is received
    Then one decision record, one instruction request, one clock and one answer are made
    Then the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC10 The partner clock is 2 working days from reference data (BR8)
    Given the case is in state FIRM_INSTRUCTED with the instruction issued
    When the partner clock is read from the working-day calendar in force
    Then the clock is 2 working days on that calendar and is not a constant of the code

  Scenario: AC11 No personal data enters the step (BR9)
    Given the step carries case and firm references, document references, codes, dates and a rule version
    When the decision record, a log and the workflow input are inspected
    Then no person name, address, contact value or identity number is found

  Scenario: AC12 Rule R-LIT-28 marks the breach when the clock expires (BR12, X10)
    Given the case is in state FIRM_INSTRUCTED and the instruction is past due with no filing
    When the partner clock expires
    Then the instruction is marked breached and FIRM_BREACHED_SLA is answered with the partner-and-agency-manager task
    Then the breach is recorded
